config_dir.description: Path to the aMule configuration directory (overriding default ~/.aMule)

log_to_stdout.description: If true, log messages are printed to stdout instead of files

disable_fatal.description: If true, fatal exceptions are not handled (useful for debugging)

enable_stdin.description: If true, stdin is enabled, allowing interaction via amulecmd

amuleweb_path.description: Absolute path to the amuleweb binary. If empty, the default is used.
